description.value: Rustic Reel Brewing Company is a craft microbrewery and taproom in Kelowna that channels the Okanagan lifestyle into locally-inspired beers and a community-focused gathering space. Alongside its rotating taps, the brewery runs a dedicated coffee bar, a full food menu with pub fare and wraps, and a regular slate of events including seasonal fishing derbies and weekly craft nights. It operates on a first-come, first-served basis, welcoming drop-ins without reservations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms name, address, and phone (250.862.3737 not in OSM). The food menu explicitly lists veggie patty, GF bun, and vegan nacho options; the events page references 'all day wifi' on Student Night, confirming Wi-Fi availability. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms anywhere in OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists 250.862.3737 — recommend adding to OSM.
No evidence of bike parking or racks found on website or in OSM tags; on-site verification recommended before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active craft brewery and taproom in central Kelowna with food, Wi-Fi, vegetarian/vegan/GF options, and takeout — a solid mid-ride or end-of-day stop for touring cyclists. Bike parking confirmation would strengthen the listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Food menu lists veggie patty sub, GF bun option, 'Make it GF/Vegan' nacho variant, falafel Mediterranean Wrap, Black Bean Quesadilla, and vegan falafel crumble add-on

wow_evidence: craft microbrewery and taproom... community-focused gathering space... all day wifi
